programs.title: Fencing for Kids
programs.tagline: For children aged 6 to 12 who want to play, move and feel like real fencers.

programs.title: Fencing for Adults
programs.tagline: For teenagers from 13 and adults who fancy trying something different.

programs.title: Wheelchair Fencing
programs.tagline: Classes for people with a physical disability: an inclusive sport with all the excitement of a bout.

values.title: Team spirit
values.body: Fencing is an individual sport, but in the club we are a team. Nobody wins or loses alone, and there is always someone to lend you a hand.

values.title: Guided learning
values.body: Your coaches are with you from your very first class right up to top-level competition. It takes more than picking up a sword and saying "touché": you learn, you work up a sweat and you enjoy it.

values.title: Inclusion
values.body: We teach fencing from the age of 6 and we include wheelchair fencing. There is a place for everyone here, whatever your age or previous fitness.
